channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Italy’s Winter Olympics security plan keeps ICE in advisory role
item.description: Italy to control Olympic security operations with 6,000 officers, drones and cyberunit, but ICE will be present.

item.title: Video emerges of Dutch police assault on two Muslim women
item.description: Two Muslim women who were kicked and hit by a police officer in Utrecht have made a formal complaint.

item.title: Israel raids several occupied West Bank towns after killing Hebron youth
item.description: Raids come as Israeli settlers storm Joseph's Tomb in Nablus, said to be the burial ground of biblical father of Jesus.

item.title: Video: Palestinians in Gaza wait for vital Rafah crossing to open
item.description: Palestinians in Gaza are waiting with uncertainty for the partial Israeli reopening of Gaza’s Rafah border crossing.

item.title: Why is the UK’s Keir Starmer in China and what does he want to achieve?
item.description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer has portrayed his trip as a pragmatic move to improve UK-China relations.

item.title: Why is ‘Deuce Bigalow’ rooting for Viktor Orban in Hungary?
item.description: A washed-up American comedian’s endorsement offers a window into Hungary’s central role in the global far right.

item.title: China bans 73 and punishes top football clubs in latest corruption scandal
item.description: China's former football chief and national team coach are among 73 to receive lifetime bans for match-fixing.

item.title: Anti-ICE protesters tear-gassed outside Texas detention centre
item.description: Anti-ICE protesters tear-gassed outside Texas detention centre

item.title: Iran-US tensions soar: What do both sides want?
item.description: From enriched uranium and ballistic missiles to sanctions and regional influence, the differences are many.

item.title: Family blames ICE for disabled son’s death after father’s detention
item.description: Wael Tarabishi died after weeks in intensive care while his father, his primary caregiver, was held in ICE detention.
